purpose: Separate schedule, block boundary and capacity effects; no calibrated PPA claim
precision: homogeneous FP32 byte accounting; numerical FP32/FP64 microchecks separate; no BF16/FP8 qualification

resource_contract.weights: stream every weight once per token tile; independent token tiles reload weights
resource_contract.kv: external persistent cache; same query-group and key tiling in paired schedules
resource_contract.compute_time: not modeled; no throughput or pin-count claims
resource_contract.bank_access: logical tensor read/write accounting, not calibrated SRAM transactions or register tiling

limitations: No actual model weights or token-quality evaluation
Attention core excludes projections, RoPE, normalization and FFN
Dense causal work includes masked positions
Capacity failure concerns the selected schedule, not all schedules
Model structure survey is broader than numerical execution coverage
